datasets.name: Most Streamed Spotify Songs 2024
datasets.description: About 4,600 of the most streamed songs of 2024, with streaming, playlist, video and radio numbers from more than a dozen platforms.
datasets.author: Nidula Elgiriyewithana
datasets.changes: Modified from the original CSV: converted to a SQLite table named songs, text decoded as Windows-1252, numbers with thousands separators converted to real numbers, release dates converted to YYYY-MM-DD, the empty TIDAL Popularity column removed, and 2 rows with a repeated ISRC removed.
notes: Roughly 1 in 9 track, album or artist names lost their accented characters before this data reached us (for example Beyoncé appears as Beyoncï¿). That damage is in the original file and can't be repaired.
Many numeric columns have missing values, which show up as NULL. For example, almost half of the songs have no SiriusXM spins.
